grammar.title: Returning home with 回国
grammar.explanation: 回国 (huíguó) means "to return to one's home country" combining 回 (return) and 国 (country).

grammar.title: Delivering something with 送到
grammar.explanation: 送到 (sòngdào) means "to deliver to, to see someone to (a place)" a verb + result complement showing something or someone arrives via the sending.

sentences.pinyin: Xìn sòngdào nǐ jiā le ma?
sentences.en: Has the letter been delivered to your home?

sentences.zh: 这个东西送到办公室了。
sentences.en: This item has been delivered to the office.
The medicine has already been delivered.
He's returning to his home country next year.
I plan to return to my home country soon.
She hasn't returned to her home country yet.
When are you returning to your home country?
